content_sections.heading: About NIDM
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Disaster Management is an institute under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, with its Delhi Campus in Rohini, New Delhi. The post sits in its Building & Maintenance Section, whose purpose is to supervise and coordinate the section's activities and ensure effective maintenance and upkeep of the Institute's assets and facilities.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice asks applicants to ensure they meet the eligibility criteria before applying. The post is a single position, and the Terms of Reference list the following. Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution. Serving/Retired Central/State Govt. officers as a Chief Engineer / Superintendent Engineer or in equivalent rank in Pay Level 13 / 14 (7CPC) from PWD/CPWD/DDA and other department. Minimum 25 years of experience in handling in the relevant field, especially projects in Central/State Govt. Proficiency in Computer handling - MS Word, Excel, Power Point, Email. Minimum 25 years' post-qualification experience in maintenance and upkeep of Government buildings, institutional campuses, commercial complexes, or similar infrastructure. Knowledge of Government procurement procedures, General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, and contract management. Master's Degree in Civil Engineering/ Law/ Management from a recognized University/Institution. Prior working experience in Govt./Training Institute/Disaster Management. Fluency in written and spoken Hindi and English is required. The upper age limit is a maximum of 62 years; the notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full Terms of Reference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration, allowances and leave entitlements are as per the provisions laid down in MoF, DoE OM No. 3-25/2020,E.III.A dated 09/12/2020. The notice adds that the remuneration may commensurate with the qualifications, experience and profile of the candidate. The consultancy is initially for 1 year and extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. The engagement is full-time, and the Sr. Consultant shall not take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy in NIDM. The Sr. Consultant reports to the Executive Director, NIDM, and shall complete the assigned tasks in a time-bound manner.

content_sections.heading: NIDM Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Terms of Reference list these tasks for the post: Supervise, monitor and coordinate all works for construction, repair, maintenance and upkeep of the upcoming project of the DRR Museum building and café at NIDM, covering civil, electrical, plumbing and other infrastructure works, timely completion, quality control and regular maintenance of the building and its facilities. Oversee the maintenance and upkeep of the Institute's buildings, campus infrastructure and allied facilities. Supervise the operation and maintenance of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, fire safety, water supply, sewage and other utility systems. Monitor the execution of annual maintenance contracts (AMCs), comprehensive maintenance contracts (CMCs) and other maintenance works, ensuring compliance with contract terms and conditions. Inspect maintenance works regularly and ensure timely rectification of defects and breakdowns. Coordinate with CPWD, local authorities, service providers, contractors and other agencies for maintenance-related matters. Prepare estimates, technical specifications, maintenance schedules, work orders and inspection reports for routine and special maintenance works. Assist in procurement of maintenance-related materials, equipment and services in accordance with the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, and other applicable Government instructions. Maintain records relating to maintenance activities, assets, inspections, repairs, complaints, inventories and contract performance. Ensure compliance with safety standards, statutory requirements, environmental regulations, and fire and electrical safety norms applicable to the Institute. Monitor housekeeping, sanitation, landscaping, waste management and upkeep of common areas. Coordinate preventive and periodic maintenance of Institute assets to ensure uninterrupted functioning of essential services. Prepare periodic reports on maintenance activities, expenditure, pending works and the condition of Institute assets for submission to the Competent Authority. Attend to emergency maintenance requirements and coordinate prompt restoration of essential services. Any other task assigned by the Executive Director, NIDM/Reporting Officer. Promoting the vision of NIDM; advising, leading and supervising; formulating concepts and strategies; managing resources. Demonstrating and safeguarding ethics and integrity; displaying cultural, gender, religion and age sensitivity and adaptability. Ability to work in a team situation and engage diverse stakeholders; ability to plan, organize, implement and report on work. Inter-personal and communication skills; proactive engagement and dialogue; strategic advice and communication; excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency with MS office suite and other software.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIDM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the eligibility criteria in the Terms of Reference before applying. Apply online through the Google form link printed in the notice (see Important Links). Submit the application on or before 25 November 2026, up to 23:59:59 hrs. For queries, contact NIDM on Tel: 011-20873404 or email [email protected] . The notice names no documents to be uploaded or enclosed.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Depending on the number of applications received, NIDM may fix the shortlisting/selection criteria. Only shortlisted candidates may be informed, through email or telephone, and called for a written test or personal interaction. No TA/DA is paid for attending the written test or personal interaction. The notice gives no date or venue for these.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NIDM reserves unfettered right to accept/reject any/all applications without assigning any reasons. The Sr. Consultant is governed under NIDM's procedure and guidelines for engagement of consultants. The engagement is temporary in nature, and NIDM can terminate it at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason. In the normal course it gives 45 days notice, and the consultant can also seek termination on giving 45 days notice to NIDM. All matters related to termination are handled by the Admin Section, irrespective of Division.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) vacancy, for Sr. Consultant (Maintenance/Engineering) in the Building & Maintenance Section.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIDM Sr. Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 25 November 2026, up to 23:59:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIDM Sr. Consultant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution, along with a minimum of 25 years of experience. Serving or retired Chief Engineer / Superintendent Engineer-level officers in Pay Level 13 / 14 (7CPC) are also listed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NIDM Sr. Consultant?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is a maximum of 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIDM Sr. Consultant?
faq.answer: Remuneration, allowances and leave entitlements are as per MoF, DoE OM No. 3-25/2020,E.III.A dated 09/12/2020. The notice says the remuneration may commensurate with qualifications, experience and profile of the candidate.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NIDM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the Google form link given in the notice before 25 November 2026, 23:59:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: NIDM may fix shortlisting/selection criteria depending on the number of applications. Only shortlisted candidates may be informed and called for a written test or personal interaction.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIDM Sr. Consultant post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on a contractual basis. The consultancy is initially for 1 year and extendable up to a maximum of 5 years, and the engagement is temporary in nature.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired officers apply for this NIDM post?
faq.answer: The eligibility list names serving or retired Central/State Govt. officers who held the rank of Chief Engineer / Superintendent Engineer or equivalent in Pay Level 13 / 14 (7CPC). Remuneration is as per the MoF, DoE OM cited in the notice.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the test or interaction?
